mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN canonical_book_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE canonical_book_id END AS canonicalBookId, MAX(book_url) AS bookUrl, MAX(book_name) AS bookName, MAX(author) AS author, MAX(cover_url) AS coverUrl, MAX(source_id) AS sourceId, MAX(source_name) AS sourceName, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS shelfCount FROM t_bookshelf_book GROUP BY canonical_book_id, CASE WHEN canonical_book_id IS NULL THEN book_url END ORDER BY shelfCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
